hints.title: Distance Metric
hints.text: The distance to zero is the absolute value abs(x).

hints.title: Tie-Breaking Rule
hints.text: If two numbers have the same absolute value (e.g. -2 and 2), pick the larger number (2).

hints.title: Single Pass Evaluation
hints.text: Iterate through nums maintaining the best candidate, updating when abs(x) is strictly smaller, or when abs(x) equals the minimum distance and x > best.

hints.title: Extrema Scan Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass compares distance and handles tie-breaks.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sorting takes O(n log n), while a single scan takes linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes clear single-pass scan with proper tie-break condition.
